speaker: Zira
text: Welcome everyone. Today we are discussing the new library opening hours.

speaker: David
text: I think extending the evening hours would help students who work during the day.

speaker: Hanhan
text: I agree. Many of my classmates study late at night.

speaker: David
text: Weekends are less important in my opinion. Most people stay home.

speaker: Hanhan
text: I disagree. Saturday mornings are very busy at the library.

speaker: Zira
text: Interesting. Do we have any data on that?

speaker: Hanhan
text: Yes. Last semester the visitor count on Saturday was almost as high as on Monday.

speaker: David
text: Okay, that is a good point. Maybe we should keep weekends as they are.

speaker: Zira
text: Let's summarize. Longer evenings, and no change to the weekend schedule.
